Research position overview

IMPRS Science and Technology of Nano-Systems offers funded PhD positions in Halle. Applicants choose from the advertised research projects and follow each project's application instructions, with research based at the Max Planck Institute and its university partner.

Research Areas

  • Nanoscience
  • Materials science
  • Physics

About Max Planck Society

The Max Planck Society operates research institutes and International Max Planck Research Schools in Germany. Doctoral candidates work within a selected institute or partner university, with funding and supervision arranged through the programme or project.
